non_confirmed_claims.limitation: Do not name a creator from non-Wizards sources.
Accounts may be complementary rather than contradictory (shared final battle); the Apocalypse novel is not ingested, so the precise sequence is unresolved here.
The guide states Old Phyrexia was destroyed but does not explicitly tie the destruction to the same battle.
The source does not name the war or the ancestor.
Belzenlok's claims are in-story propaganda; this pack does not resolve the forger.
'White star' is Slimefoot's perception; identifying it with the Powerstone is an inference.
These are in-story assessments; later official stories show a Phyrexian threat to Dominaria.
Ep. 11 states he took it back; that the stone in Ep. 6 is the mechanism is an inference across episodes.
The episode says 'the Sylex'; identity with the Golgothian Sylex is inferred.
In-story statement by Karn; see Pack B B012.
The quoted lines do not name who swings the axe; the attribution to Ajani follows from Norn's order in the preceding paragraph.
Stated within Atraxa's question, not by the narrator; Ajani's activity on Theros is not modelled from Episode 6 here.
'They' in the first quote is the group in the scene; the precise membership is not restated in the quote.
The quotes juxtapose Wrenn's act and the portal; they do not say in one sentence that Wrenn made it. Wrenn's death is not asserted: the text says only that she is dying.
The mechanism of Zhalfir's return is not modelled from these quotes.
